q.t: How many paise make 1 rupee?
q.e: 1 rupee is split into 100 small parts called paise.

q.t: How many 50 paise coins make ₹1?
Rupal had ₹50. She spent ₹30 on rides. How much is left?
A ride ticket costs ₹20. How much for 2 tickets?
Which is more money: one ₹100 note or one ₹50 note?
q.e: 100 is more than 50 — in fact two ₹50 notes make ₹100.

q.t: Ajay has ₹58. He spends ₹48. How much is left?
Which note is worth the most?
How many 25 paise coins make ₹1?
How many 20 paise coins make ₹1?
Jayant spent ₹25 on pens and ₹40 on notebooks. How much did he spend in all?
Meera has ₹43. Kanika has ₹14 more than Meera. How much does Kanika have?
Bread costs ₹30 and a chocolate costs ₹60. How much for both?
Father gave you ₹40 for the fair. You came home with ₹6. How much did you spend?
q.e: Spent = what you had − what is left = 40 − 6 = 34. Check: 34 + 6 = 40.

q.t: To pay ₹66 you use one ₹50 note, one ₹10 note, one ₹5 coin and one more coin. Which coin?
q.e: 50 + 10 + 5 = 65, and you need 1 more rupee to make 66.

q.t: A ride costs ₹15 per ticket. How much for 2 tickets?
Which of these makes exactly ₹20?

q.e: Adding 5 tens to 47: 4 tens + 5 tens = 9 tens, ones stay 7. So ₹97.

q.t: Matru pays ₹10 for 3 chances at ‘pop the balloon’. How much does he pay for 9 chances?
q.e: 9 chances is 3 lots of 3 chances, and 3 × ₹10 = ₹30.

q.t: A red balloon wins ₹5, a blue one ₹10 and a green one ₹2. Matru pops one of each. How much does he win?
You want to make ₹85. You have one ₹50 note and one ₹20 note. How many more rupees do you need?
You have ₹50. You buy a toy for ₹28 and a ball for ₹15. How much is left?
Which is a correct way to make ₹54?
4 coins of 25 paise make how many rupees?
How many 10 paise coins make ₹1?
Rupal spends ₹10, ₹15 and ₹20 on three rides. How much does she spend in all?
A friend had ₹50. She spent ₹20 on rides, ₹20 on snacks and ₹2 on candies. How much is left?
You have ₹30. A toy costs ₹55. How much more money do you need?
q.e: Count on from 30 to 55: that is 25 more.

q.t: You have ₹100. You buy a book for ₹45 and a pen for ₹30. How much is left?
Meera has ₹43. Kanika has ₹14 more than Meera. How much do they have together?
You have two ₹20 notes and three ₹5 coins. You spend ₹27. How much is left?
Matru pays ₹10 for 3 chances. He pops a blue (₹10), another blue (₹10) and a red (₹5) balloon. How much more did he win than he paid?
q.e: He wins 10 + 10 + 5 = 25 and paid 10, so 25 − 10 = 15 more.

q.t: Ajay had ₹58. He spent ₹48 at the market. Then his mother gave him ₹25. How much does he have now?
Rita buys 5 pencils at ₹4 each and pays with a ₹50 note. How much change does she get?
Two 50 paise coins and four 25 paise coins make how many rupees?
q.e: Two 50 paise = ₹1 and four 25 paise = ₹1, so ₹2 in all.

q.t: Which costs more: 3 rides at ₹15 each or 2 rides at ₹20 each?
q.e: 15 + 15 + 15 = 45 and 20 + 20 = 40, so the 3 rides cost more.

q.t: Sonu has three ₹10 notes. He wants a toy that costs ₹55. How much more does he need?
You pay ₹85 using four ₹20 notes and some ₹5 coins. How many ₹5 coins?
q.e: Four ₹20 notes make 80, and 85 − 80 = 5, which is one ₹5 coin.
